payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute divisor counts, then DP over n with 1D state: ans[i] = var[i-1] + tau(i), var[i] = var[i-1] + ans[i].
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 1D iteration over i from 1 to n, maintaining two scalar DP variables (ans and var), which is a classic dp_1d_state pattern.
